title: Hieromnemon
summary: HIEROM'NEMON, noun [Gr. sacred, and preserving memory.] In ancient Greece, a magistrate who presided over the sacred rites and solemnities, etc.

inlines.v: HIEROM'NEMON, noun [Gr. sacred, and preserving memory.] In ancient Greece, a magistrate who presided over the sacred rites and solemnities, etc.
